name: Tinted amber glass slab desk

reasons: Single three-quarter view; the back long edge, the rear faces of both end panels and the whole slab underside are inferred by mirroring.
Transmissive tinted glass: read colour mixes body tint with the backdrop, so albedo hexes are estimates with transmission stacking removed.
Bronze L-brackets are small and motion-soft: plate outline is readable, fastener count and bracket width are approximated.
Macro silhouette (open inverted-U of three glass planes) is unambiguous and bilaterally symmetric, so the hidden half is safely inferable.

materials.subtype: amber body-tinted float glass, polished both faces
amber body-tinted float glass panel 0.015 m, vertical transmission gradient

mustMatch: Exactly three glass planes: a 1.40 x 0.65 x 0.015 m horizontal slab whose top face is 0.72 m above the floor, and two 0.60 x 0.702 x 0.015 m vertical end panels - no apron, stretcher, leg or drawer anywhere
Each end panel's outer face is 0.035 m inboard of the slab end edge (panel mid-planes at x = -0.6575 and +0.6575 m, 1.315 m apart on centres)
Each end panel is set back 0.025 m from both long edges of the slab, so 0.60 m panel depth is centred in the 0.65 m slab depth

Four bronze L-brackets only, one per inner top corner: vertical leg 0.13 m down the panel, horizontal leg 0.10 m under the slab, plate 0.005 m thick and 0.03 m wide, top arris flush with the slab underside at y = 0.705 m
The two brackets on each panel are 0.40 m apart on centres (z = +0.20 and -0.20 m)
Glass thickness is a uniform 0.015 m on slab and panels, with vertical panel corners kept as hard arrises of radius <= 0.001 m
niceToHave: Bottom 0.15 m of each panel reads visibly darker and browner (#6E3312) than the upper band (#A0521F), as transmission density rather than paint
Exposed 0.015 m slab edges read one step darker (#8C4418) than the top face
Thin dark contact shadow seam along the full 0.60 m top edge of each panel where it meets the slab underside
Four frosted pads, 0.03 m long, on the bottom edge of each panel near its front and back corners
Two visible screw heads per bracket leg, 0.006 m diameter, barely proud of the plate
